question.text:
For the thermal decomposition of $\mathrm{N}_2 \mathrm{O}_5(\mathrm{~g})$ at constant volume, the following table can be formed, for the reaction mentioned below. $2 \mathrm{~N}_2 \mathrm{O}_5(\mathrm{~g}) \rightarrow 2 \mathrm{~N}_2 \mathrm{O}_4(\mathrm{~g})+\mathrm{O}_2(\mathrm{~g})$
$\mathrm{x}=\ldots \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~atm} \text { [nearest integer] }$ Given : Rate constant for the reaction is $4.606 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$.
